if-the-player-has-less-than-80-shayzien-.npc: Don't expect me to deal with the likes of you.

if-the-player-has-less-than-80-shayzien-.text: You do not have enough Shayzien favour. Current favour: [current favour in %] - Required: 80.0%

if-the-player-has-less-than-80-shayzien-.npc: If you're planning on fighting me for a set of my armour, I'm afraid I'm not interested. The combat XP from fighting you isn't worthwhile. Get a Defence level of 20 first.

if-the-player-does-not-have-a-full-set-o.npc: If you're hoping to fight me for a piece of my armour, you've got to own a full set of the tier 2 armour first. Try fighting my subordinate.

if-the-player-has-a-full-set-of-tier-2-a.npc: Fancy a fight? The combat practice would be good for me. I'll give you a piece of my armour if you win.

steps.npc: I'll be here if you ever change your mind. I love a good fight.

if-the-player-does-not-have-the-full-set.npc: Fancy another fight? The combat practice is good for me. I'll give you some more of my armour if you win.

if-the-player-has-the-full-set-of-tier-3.npc: Don't you already have a set of my armour?
